verdict.rationale: ADK ships a built-in dev Web UI for testing/debugging/evaluating agents and callbacks for logging/monitoring hooks, plus eval trajectory reporting showing tool-call sequences, which together provide visibility into LLM/tool invocations during a run. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated tracing UI showing full call-by-call traces (spans, latencies, token-level detail) comparable to a dedicated observability product, nor mention of OpenTelemetry/trace export integration. Missing for 10: explicit trace/span-level UI documentation, integration with external observability backends (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Langfuse), and independent hands-on confirmation of trace granularity.
